```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
#devtools::load_all()
library(ggplot2)
library(poolfstat)
library(zoo)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```
  
# VCF
## Load data
```{r, eval=FALSE}

all.sample.info <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "all.sample.info.csv"), sep=";", header=FALSE)

dim(all.sample.info)
rownames(all.sample.info) <-  all.sample.info[, 1]

## Load sample names with no filter on q20
vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "wRI.vcf.gz")
#vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "wRI.filtered.vcf.gz")
## Name of samples
seq.names <- unlist(strsplit(grep("^#CHROM", readLines(vcf_path), value = TRUE), "\t"))
seq.names <- seq.names[-(1:9)]

data.frame(seq.names, rownames(all.sample.info))

## Read data
wSuz.pooldata=vcf2pooldata(vcf.file=vcf_path, poolsizes = all.sample.info[,2],poolnames = rownames(all.sample.info), min.maf=0.01, min.cov.per.pool=-1)



## SNP infos
head(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info)

## 98 SNPs
wSuz.pooldata@nsnp

## 27 samples
wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

## Matrix for coverage and readcounts with SNPs in rows and samples in columns
head(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage[, 1:20])

head(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, 1:20])


```

## Select samples
```{r, eval=FALSE}
samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "D-sub", "CN-Kun_KM5" , "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1" )

## Filter CI individuals
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(rownames(all.sample.info)%in% samples))

## Export genotypes
geno_data <- round(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2)

## Add positions
geno_data <- data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info, geno_data)
colnames(geno_data) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

head(geno_data, n=50)
write.table(x=geno_data, file=here::here("data/derived_data/wol_genotypes.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```

# Check MAF across samples
As expected from the presence of a single Wolbachia genotype, the MAF boxplot on the called SNPs shows a reduced genetic diversity in Individual, Iso-female and Colony sample (@fig-wSuzmaf). Still, some polymorphism is found at some SNPs (this may also be related to coverage heterogeneity)?
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8 
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the MAF of called wRI sites on all the samples ."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wSuzmaf

wSuz.maf <- 0.5-abs(0.5-wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage)

colnames(wSuz.maf) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames
boxplot(wSuz.maf,horizontal=T,las=1,xlab="MAF")

```

# Check call rate
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## The 98 SNPs of the 7 samples are well covered
ind.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2, function(x) sum(x != 0)/nrow(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))

ind.callrate
data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@poolnames, ind.callrate)
hist(ind.callrate)

## Filter 0 individual samples with fewer than 80% of the SNPs covered
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(ind.callrate>0.8))


## 110 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
snp.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 1, function(x) sum(x != 0)/ncol(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))
hist(snp.callrate)

## Filter XX SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  snp.index = which(snp.callrate>0.9))
```

# PCA and clustering
## PCA
```{r, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(1234)
par(xpd=TRUE)
res.pca <- poolfstat::randomallele.pca(x = wSuz.pooldata, plot.pcs = c(1, 2), return.snploadings = TRUE)

```

## Clustering of variants
```{r, eval=FALSE}
fstats <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(x=wSuz.pooldata, output.pairwise.div = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, computeF3 = FALSE, computeF4 = FALSE)

## Export divergence
fstats@pairwise.div

## Hirarchical clustering equivalent to UPGMA
tt <- hclust(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div), method= "average")
plot(tt)

## Neighbor joining distance
tt <- ape::nj(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div))
plot(tt)

#quartz()
## Heatmap
heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div, distfun = as.dist)

## With ComplexHeatmap
div.hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div,
cluster_rows =TRUE,cluster_columns=TRUE,name="Divergence",
show_heatmap_legend=FALSE,column_title = "Divergence (1-Q2)")

div.hm

```
